data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Decentralization increases resilience to 'Logic-Based' correlated failures but decreases resilience to 'Resource-Based' correlated failures.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The large service's redundancy is logically coupled (e.g., same bug deployed to all regions).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The decentralized services are distributed across an exceptionally diverse set of physical substrates.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Logic-based failures (e.g., a specific edge-case bug in a protocol) are mitigated by the diversity of implementations in a decentralized network.
